title: Course Planning Web Application
content: Project: Course Planning Web Application Category: Side Project Technologies: JavaScript (React), CSS (Bootstrap), Python, MongoDB GitHub: https://github.com/doryang1019/course-tracking-system-frontend During my course planning, I often found myself gathering information from various sources — tracking mandatory courses, understanding prerequisites, and checking availability. This multi-step process was time-consuming and error-prone. To solve this, I built a web application that consolidates all relevant course data in one place, complete with a visual course map. Students can see prerequisite chains at a glance and track their status — yet to take, enrolled, or completed. The application is being developed using JavaScript (React) for the frontend, Python for the backend API, and MongoDB for persistent storage. The goal is to eliminate the friction from academic planning entirely.

title: Household Resale Android App
content: Project: Household Resale Android App Category: Course Project Technologies: Java, SQLite, Android Studio GitHub: https://github.com/GeaByte/household-resale-android-app A course assignment to develop a full household-items resale app for Android using Java . I led design and implementation of the app's pages and core features while teammates handled SQLite integration and CRUD operations. Key features I built include: Location and notification permission management "Nearby Me" — live listings filtered by user's GPS coordinates Sorting and filtering by price, category, and distance Full seller profile and item listing management The project reinforced my understanding of Android lifecycles, permissions, and local data persistence.

title: Online Order Website
content: Project: Online Order Website Category: Course Project Technologies: PHP (Laravel), MySQL, Bootstrap GitHub: https://github.com/GeaByte/Sandwich_Queen_Online_Order_System A full-featured online ordering system built with PHP and the Laravel framework as a course project. The site allows customers to browse a menu, place orders, and manage their accounts. Key features include authentication, a product catalogue with filtering, a shopping cart, and an order history system. Built with MySQL for data persistence and Bootstrap for a clean, responsive UI. This project deepened my understanding of MVC architecture, Eloquent ORM, and Laravel's routing system.

title: MERN Family Todo App
content: Project: MERN Family Todo App Category: Course Project Technologies: React, Express, MongoDB, Node.js, Axios A full-stack MERN application built for a course project. Features RESTful APIs for authentication, task management, and family user grouping — allowing multiple household members to share and manage tasks. Used MongoDB with Mongoose for schema flexibility. Optimised Axios calls to reduce data-fetch overhead. JWT-based auth secures all routes. This project reinforced my understanding of SPA architecture, API design, and state management in React.
